title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 07, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B9.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.6 (Peaked November 07, 2026 at 13:41 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.2 (Peaked November 07, 2026 at 12:43 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 527 km/s (Elevated)
🧲 Bz: +7.9 nT (Northward)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

C-Class flare! 💥🌌

Today’s solar images show a broad coronal-hole region and several bright active areas, while the coronagraph view looks routine.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
